item.title: DP to Hold Public Briefing on Criminal Procedure Act on the 3rd…“Will Fully Explain Public Questions” (민주, 3일 형소법 대국민보고회 연다…“국민 궁금증 충분히 설명할 것”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has decided to establish an internal body to prepare measures to strengthen the rights of crime victims among socially vulnerable groups as soon as the Criminal Procedure Act, which completely abolishes prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights, is processed. It also decided to hold a public briefing on the Criminal Procedure Act on the 3rd of next month. (더불어민주당은 ‘검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 형사소송법 처리되는 대로 사회적 약자 대상 범죄 피해자 권익 강화 방안을 마련하기 위해 당내 기구를 설치하기로 했다. 또, 내달 3일 형사소송법 대국민 보고회를 개최하기로 했다.)

Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a supreme council meeting on the 31st, “Today’s revision of the Criminal Procedure Act is not the end of prosecution reform but the beginning of a new criminal justice system. In the process of launching the new system, there must be no gaps in protecting the rights of the people or any vacuum in investigations.” (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 31일 최고위원회의에서 “오늘의 형사소송법 개정은 검찰개혁의 끝이 아닌 새로운 형사사법 체계의 시작이다. 새로운 제도 출범 과정에서 국민의 권리 보호에 빈틈이 생기거나 수사 공백이 발생하는 일이 없어야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The revision bill to the Criminal Procedure Act, centered on the complete abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights, was tabled at the National Assembly plenary session the previous day, and is expected to pass by vote once the unlimited debate (filibuster) concludes in the afternoon. Floor Leader Han said, “The Democratic Party will fully explain the public’s questions and carefully review any concerns raised,” adding, “We will thoroughly manage follow-up statutes and institutional arrangements and take full responsibility to ensure the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Service are launched stably on October 2.” (검찰의 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 뼈대로 한 형사소송법 개정안은 전날 국회 본회의에 상정됐고, 이날 오후 무제한 토론(필리버스터)이 종료되면 표결에 부쳐져 통과될 전망이다. 한 원내대표는 “민주당은 국민 여러분의 궁금증을 충분히 설명하고 제기되는 우려도 꼼꼼히 살필 것”이라며 “후속 법령과 제도 정비까지 빈틈없이 챙겨 10월2일 중대범죄수사청과 공소청이 안정적으로 출범할 수 있도록 끝까지 책임을 다하겠다”라고 했다.)

Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party's Chung Jeom-sik: "Abolishing Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Rights Is the End of the Rule of Law" (국힘 정점식 “검사 보완수사권 폐지는 법치주의의 종말”)
item.description:
The People Power Party on the 31st pushed back against the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, which would completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights and is scheduled to be processed at the National Assembly plenary session, calling it "the end of the rule of law." (국민의힘이 31일 국회 본회의에서 처리될 예정인 ‘검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 형사소송법 개정안을 “법치주의의 종말”이라고 반발했다.)

Chung Jeom-sik, the People Power Party's floor leader, made these remarks at a floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly that day, saying, "If the supplementary investigation rights disappear, ordinary citizens will suffer from poor and delayed investigations, and those without money or power will suffer even more." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 원내대책회의를 열고 “보완수사권이 사라지면 평범한 국민은 부실 수사, 늑장 수사 등으로 고통받고, 돈 없고 힘 없으면 더욱 더 고통받을 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Floor leader Chung said, "Furthermore, the Democratic Party secretly inserted a provision that relaxes the court's dismissal of indictment, allowing for the deletion of a trial against the president. They have committed a shameless deception, akin to palming cards in a rigged gambling game, in the National Assembly, which should uphold the law." He added, "Is the 'working National Assembly' the Democratic Party talks about nothing more than a body that paves an escape route to delete Lee Jae-myung's presidential trial?" He then warned, "If this bad law passes, many side effects will soon emerge, and when that time comes, the massive anger of the public will judge the Democratic Party." (정 원내대표는 “민주당은 게다가 대통령에 대한 재판을 삭제할 수 있는 법원의 공소기각 완화 조항을 몰래 끼워넣었다. 법을 수호해야 할 국회에서 사기도박의 밑장빼기와 같은 파렴치한 속임수를 자행한 것”이라며 “민주당이 말하는 ‘일하는 국회’가 고작 이재명 대통령의 재판 삭제를 위해 도피로를 깔아주는 일을 하는 국회라는 것인가”라고 말했다. 이어 그는 “이 악법이 통과되면 머지않아 많은 부작용이 생길 것이고, 그때가 되면 거대한 민심의 분노가 민주당을 심판할 것”이라고 경고했다.)

The revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, currently under unlimited debate (filibuster) in the National Assembly, is expected to be processed at the plenary session after a vote to close debate around 4:07 p.m. that day. Following that, a revision to the National Assembly Act, which shortens the review period for bills designated as fast-track from up to 330 days to 90 days, is set to be introduced. (현재 국회에서 무제한 토론(필리버스터)이 진행 중인 형사소송법 개정안은 이날 오후 4시7분께 토론 종결 표결을 거쳐 본회의에서 처리될 전망이다. 이어 패스트트랙으로 지정된 법안의 심사기간을 최장 330일에서 90일로 단축하는 내용의 국회법 개정안이 상정될 예정이다.)

Floor leader Chung also said of the National Assembly Act revision, "It is a dictatorial bad law that treats the National Assembly as the Democratic Party's rubber stamp and aims to turn it into a machine that raises its hand even faster in the future." He added, "The Democratic Party should learn a lesson from hastily introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs without sufficient review or deliberation, which caused great chaos in the stock market." The People Power Party has also signaled a filibuster against the National Assembly Act revision, so the bill is expected to be put to a vote at the first plenary session of the August extraordinary session. (정 원내대표는 국회법 개정안에 대해서도 “국회를 민주당의 거수기로 여기고 앞으로 더 빨리 손드는 기계로 만들겠다는 독재 악법”이라고 말했다. 이어 “민주당은 단일종목 레버리지 ETF를 충분한 검토와 숙의 없이 졸속 도입했다가 주식시장에 대혼란을 초래한 것에서 교훈을 얻어야 한다”고 덧붙였다. 국민의힘은 국회법 개정안에 대해서도 필리버스터를 예고해, 개정안은 8월 임시국회 첫 본회의에서 표결에 부쳐질 전망이다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party leadership "Taking leverage risks seriously... to swiftly establish investor protection body" (민주 수뇌부 “레버리지 엄중 인식…투자자 보호기구 조속 구성 ”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 31st, "We are taking the current market situation and investors' concerns very seriously," adding, "We will calmly and transparently review whether the process of introducing single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and investor protection measures were sufficient." The domestic stock market has seen repeated sharp fluctuations, centered on major semiconductor stocks such as SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, with volatility increasing. (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 31일 “현재의 시장 상황과 투자자 여러분의 우려를 엄중하게 인식하고 있다”며 “단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 상품 도입 과정과 투자자 보호 장치가 충분했는지 차분하고 투명하게 점검하겠다”고 밝혔다. 국내 증시는 에스케이(SK)하이닉스와 삼성전자 등 대형 반도체주를 중심으로 연일 급등락을 반복하며 변동성이 커진 상황이다.)

Floor leader Han said, "We need to comprehensively examine complex factors, including the sharp rises and falls in global semiconductor stocks and the supply-demand structure concentrated on specific stocks, and find proper solutions," adding, "The Democratic Party will closely communicate with financial authorities and the industry, centering on the K-Capital Market Special Committee, and carefully monitor the effectiveness of implemented measures and market reactions." (한 원내대표는 “글로벌 반도체주의 급등락과 특정 종목에 집중된 수급 구조 등 복합적인 요인을 총체적으로 점검하고, 제대로 된 해법을 찾아야 한다”며 “민주당은 케이(K)-자본시장 특별위원회를 중심으로 금융당국 및 업계와 긴밀히 소통하며 시행되는 조치의 효과와 시장 반응을 세심하게 살피겠다”고 말했다.)

Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu proposed "swiftly establishing a special body to complement the leverage system and protect investors, together with the party's policy committee, government financial authorities, and private market experts." Supreme Council member Park Kyu-hwan said, "In particular, the asset base of ordinary people and young people is being shaken," adding, "We will take special measures, including a temporary suspension of trading in leveraged products, to ensure structural stability in the stock market and protect individual investors." (강득구 최고위원은 “당 정책위와 정부 금융당국, 민간시장 전문가들과 함께 레버리지 제도 보완과 투자자 보호를 위한 특별기구를 조속히 구성할 것”을 제안했다. 박규환 최고위원은 “특히 서민과 청년들의 자산 기반이 흔들리고 있다”며 “레버리지 상품의 일시적 거래 중단을 포함해 주식시장의 구조적 안정과 개인 투자자를 지키기 위한 특단의 대책을 세우도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee "Dismiss Members Who Leak Internal Discussions"... Within Party, "Cannot Silence Criticism" (국힘 윤리위 “내부 논의 유출자 해임”…당내선 “비판 입막음 안 돼”)
item.description:
Criticism is emerging within the People Power Party that the Central Ethics Committee's warning about the possible dismissal of members who leak internal discussions amounts to "muzzling" dissent. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 내부 논의를 유출한 윤리위원에 대해 해임 가능성을 경고한 것을 두고, 당내에서 “입막음”이라는 비판이 나오고 있다.)

Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja appeared on KBS Radio's "Emergency Current Affairs" on the 31st and said, "Confidentiality is a shield that protects the Ethics Committee," adding, "It should not become a tool to block criticism." She further stated, "Before the committee chair issues a strong warning about requesting dismissal, he should have first clearly defined the scope of the confidentiality obligation and what actions constitute a violation." (양향자 최고위원은 31일 한국방송(KBS) 라디오 ‘전격시사’에 출연해 “비밀 유지는 윤리위를 보호하는 방패”라며 “비판을 막는 입막음 수단이 돼서는 안 된다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “윤리위원장이 해임 요청이라는 강한 경고를 하기 전에 비밀 유지 의무의 범위가 어디까지인지, 어떤 행위가 위반에 해당하는지부터 명확하게 밝혔어야 한다”고 말했다.)

Woo Jae-joon, the People Power Party's youth supreme council member, appeared on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" the same day and said, "(Ethics Committee Chair Yoon Min-woo's remarks) are as if saying we should not say anything at all," adding, "There clearly seem to be problems within the (Ethics Committee) right now, and (because of this), biased outcomes appear to be resulting." (우재준 국민의힘 청년최고위원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “(윤민우 윤리위원장의 말은) 마치 아무런 말을 하지 말라는 것”이라며 “지금 (윤리위 내) 문제가 뻔히 있어 보이는데, (이 때문에) 결과적으로도 편향적인 결과들이 나오는 것 같다”고 했다.)

Previously, Chair Yoon Min-woo stated in a position statement the day before, "If violations of the confidentiality obligation regarding internal discussions of the Central Ethics Committee recur in the future, I will take strict measures, including requesting the party leader to dismiss the relevant committee member in accordance with relevant regulations." This is interpreted as a response to Vice Chair Woo Jong-hwan and others publicly raising issues about Yoon's unilateral management of committee meetings. The party's internal rules, the "Ethics Committee Regulations," stipulate "duties of fairness and confidentiality." (앞서 윤민우 위원장이 전날 입장문에서 “앞으로 중앙윤리위원회 내부의 논의와 관련된 비밀유지 의무 위반이 재발할 경우, 관련 규정에 따라 해당 윤리위원의 해임을 당대표에게 요청하는 등 엄정하게 조치하겠다”고 밝혔다. 우종환 윤리위 부위원장 등은 윤 위원장의 일방적인 회의 운영에 대해 공개적으로 문제를 제기하자, 이를 문제 삼은 것으로 풀이된다. 국민의힘 당규 ‘윤리위원회 규정’에는 ‘공정 및 비밀유지 의무’가 명시되어 있다.)

Supreme Council member Woo countered Yoon's statement on the radio, saying, "It's no secret that (the party's Ethics Committee) is being run arbitrarily," and "Disclosing facts about a person under disciplinary review that were learned during work constitutes a leak of secrets." (우 최고위원은 라디오에서 “(당 윤리위가) 독단적으로 운영되고 있다는 건 비밀이 아니”라며 “업무 도중 알게 된 피징계자에 대한 사실관계를 외부로 알리는 게 비밀 누설”이라고 윤 위원장의 입장문을 반박했다.)

Meanwhile, the People Power Party clashed at its Supreme Council meeting the day before over an agenda item to appoint two additional members to the party's Central Ethics Committee. During this process, Supreme Council member Woo expressed opposition, arguing that an investigation into Yoon's unilateral management of meetings and bias should take precedence, while Supreme Council member Yang abstained, saying further review was needed. (한편, 국민의힘은 전날 열린 최고위원회의에서 당 중앙윤리위원 2명을 추가 임명하는 안건을 놓고 충돌을 빚었다. 이 과정에서 우 최고위원은 윤 위원장의 독단적인 회의 운영과 편향성에 대한 조사부터 선행돼야 한다며 반대 의사를 밝혔고, 양 최고위원은 추가 검토가 필요하다며 기권했다.)

As a result of the vote, the two additional Central Ethics Committee members were appointed with a majority in favor, increasing the number of committee members from five to seven. Previously, after two Central Ethics Committee members resigned in succession, a meeting attended by only three of the five members voted to initiate disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Kwon Young-jin, Cho Kyeong-tae, and Jin Jong-oh, which had already raised questions of fairness. (표결 결과 과반의 찬성으로 중앙윤리위원 2명이 추가 임명되면서 윤리위원은 기존 5명에서 7명으로 늘어났다. 앞서 중앙윤리위원 2명이 잇달아 사임한 데 이어, 윤리위원 5명 중 3명만 참석한 회의에서 권영진·조경태·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시가 의결되면서 공정성 논란이 제기된 바 있다.)

item.title: Park Ji-won: "Prosecutors Stripped of Investigative Powers Should Blame Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon" (박지원 “수사권 박탈된 검사들, 윤석열·한동훈을 원망하라”)
item.description:
With the Criminal Procedure Act amendment abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers being brought to the National Assembly plenary session on the 30th, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won said, "If some prosecutors want to resent having their investigative powers taken away, they should blame Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon." (검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 30일 국회 본회의에 상정된 가운데, 박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 “일부 검사들이 수사권 박탈된 걸 원망을 (하려거든) 윤석열과 한동훈한테 하라”고 말했다.)

Park, a member of the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, appeared on Gwangju Broadcasting Corporation (KBC)'s "Yeouido Invitation" that day and said, "Since liberation, how much have prosecutors acted as handmaidens to dictators and military autocrats, killing and fabricating cases against innocent citizens?" adding, "Recently, especially because Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon lit the fire, the prosecution has been completely reformed." Park added, "I celebrate the success of President Lee Jae-myung's prosecution reform." (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 박 의원은 이날 광주방송(KBC) ‘여의도 초대석’에 출연해 “해방 후 지금까지 검찰이 얼마나 독재자, 군사 독재자들의 시녀로서 무고한 국민을 죽이고 조작했나”라며 “최근에 특히 윤석열, 한동훈이 불을 지르니까 완전히 (검찰이) 개혁된 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 박 의원은 “이재명 대통령의 검찰 개혁 성공을 자축한다“고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding Acting Prosecutor General Gu Ja-hyun (Deputy Prosecutor General of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office) issuing a statement on the 29th publicly opposing the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, saying "South Korea's criminal justice system will collapse," Park said, "Even with a thousand mouths, they have no right to speak." Park also said, "If the prosecution is the one that didn't even investigate Kim Keon-hee, returned her phone, and coordinated in advance, isn't that exactly what deserves reform?" This appears to reference the controversy over the so-called "imperial investigation" by the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office team that investigated First Lady Kim Keon-hee's Deutsche Motors stock manipulation and luxury bag acceptance cases during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. (구자현 검찰총장 직무대행(대검 차장)이 29일 입장문을 내어 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 “대한민국의 형사사법 체계가 무너질 것”이라며 공개적으로 반대 입장을 밝힌 데 대해선 “입이 천 개가 있어도 말을 할 자격이 없다”고 말했다. 박 의원은 “김건희를 수사도 안 하고 핸드폰 반납하고 사전에 조율해서 하는 그런 짓을 하는 게 대한민국 검찰이었다고 하면 이것은 개혁의 대상 아니냐”고도 했다. 윤석열 정부 시절 김건희 여사의 도이치모터스 주가조작과 명품백 수수 사건을 수사했던 서울중앙지검 수사팀의 이른바 ‘황제 조사’ 논란을 언급한 것으로 보인다.)

Park identified former President Yoon Suk-yeol and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon as "the very people who brought about today's prosecution reform." He said, "Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon are people who have nothing to say even with a thousand mouths," adding, "That's why I say in reverse: if some prosecutors resent having their investigative powers stripped and the prosecution dismantled, direct that resentment at Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon." (박 의원은 “오늘날 검찰 개혁을 가져온 장본인들”로 윤석열 전 대통령과 한동훈 무소속 의원을 지목했다. 그러면서 “윤석열, 한동훈은 입이 천 개라도 할 말이 없는 사람들”이라며 “그렇기 때문에 일부 검사들이 수사권 박탈되고 검찰이 해체된 것을 원망을 (하려거든 윤석열과) 한동훈한테 하라고 역으로 말씀드린다”고 했다.)

When the host mentioned former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo's recent Facebook post stating that "the prosecution being branded as a political prosecution and pushed to the brink of losing its investigative powers is entirely due to the tyranny of Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon's political prosecution," Park said, "Of course. Former Mayor Hong says a lot of right things," and reiterated, "Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is a person without the qualifications (to speak on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment)." (진행자가 “오늘날 검찰이 정치검찰로 몰려 수사권이 존폐의 기로에 몰린 것은 전적으로 윤석열·한동훈의 정치검찰 패악에서 비롯된 것”이라는 홍준표 전 대구시장의 최근 페이스북 글을 언급하자 박 의원은 “당연하다. 홍 전 시장이 옳은 말을 많이 한다”며 “한동훈 의원은 (형사소송법 개정안에 대해 말할) 자격이 없는 사람”이라고 재차 강조했다.)

Han had posted on Facebook on the 24th, when the Democratic Party confirmed the Criminal Procedure Act amendment as party policy, claiming, "The Democratic Party regime has confirmed as party policy the ban on supplementary investigations that causes enormous harm to the people. They have finally decided to side with criminals." He also described the inclusion of provisions adding grounds for dismissal of prosecution as "the Democratic Party sneaking something ugly into the Criminal Procedure Act again" (on the 29th). (한 의원은 민주당이 형사소송법 개정안을 당론으로 추인한 지난 24일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “국민에게 엄청난 피해 주는 보완수사 금지를 민주당 정권이 당론으로 확정했다. 끝내 범죄자의 편에 서기로 한 것”이라고 주장한 바 있다. 이어 형사소송법 개정안에 법원의 공소기각 사유를 추가하는 내용이 포함된 것을 두고는 “민주당이 흉한 걸 또 형사소송법에 끼워 넣었다”(29일)고 표현하기도 했다.)

Lee Yu-jin Reporter yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Average weight of Korean 19-year-old men is 73kg... obesity rate rises from 23% to 31% over 11 years (한국 19살 남성 평균 73kg…11년 새 비만 비율 23%→31%)
item.description:
The Military Manpower Administration announced on the 31st that it has registered the "Health Indicators of Korean 19-Year-Old Men," an analysis of 2.95 million physical examination records for military service spanning 11 years from those born in 1996 to 2006, as national statistics, and will annually disclose changes in the health of young Korean men going forward. (병무청은 31일 1996년생부터 2006년생까지 11년 간의 병역판정검사 자료 295만건을 분석한 ‘한국인 19세 남성 건강지표’를 국가통계로 등록하고, 앞으로 매년 우리나라 청년 남성의 건강 변화를 공개한다고 밝혔다.)

These statistics are based on physical examination data for military service administered to all 19-year-old men and include 24 indicators that reflect youth health, such as body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol, triglycerides, liver function, blood tests, and mental health. The Military Manpower Administration explained that this is significant because it allows for tracking health trends across the younger generation. (이번 통계는 19살 남성 전원을 대상으로 실시하는 병역판정검사 자료를 기반으로 구축한 것으로, 체질량지수(BMI), 혈압, 혈당, 콜레스테롤, 중성지방, 간기능, 혈액검사, 정신건강 등 청년 건강을 보여주는 24개 지표를 담고 있다. 이를 통해 청년 세대의 건강 변화 추이를 파악할 수 있다는 점에서 의미가 크다는게 병무청 설명이다.)

According to the data, the average weight of 19-year-old men increased from 69.44 kg to 73.37 kg. While the average weight of the top 10% increased by 7.8 kg over the 11-year period, the bottom 10% saw only a 0.6 kg increase, showing that weight gain among young people was relatively concentrated in the upper group. (자료를 보면, 19살 남성의 평균 체중은 69.44㎏에서 73.37㎏으로 증가했다. 상위 10%의 평균 체중은 11년간 7.8㎏ 증가한 반면, 하위 10%의 평균 체중은 0.6㎏증가에 그쳐 청년층의 체중 증가가 상위 집단에 상대적으로 집중되는 양상을 보였다.)

The obesity rate (BMI 25 or higher) rose from 23% to 31%. The obese group showed higher systolic blood pressure, total cholesterol, and triglycerides than the underweight group, indicating a tendency for risk factors for cardiovascular and metabolic diseases to increase together. (비만(BMI 25 이상) 비율은 23%에서 31%로 증가했다. 비만 그룹은 저체중 그룹보다 수축기 혈압, 총콜레스테롤, 중성지방이 모두 높게 나타나 심혈관질환과 대사질환의 위험인자가 함께 증가하는 경향을 보였다.)

The Military Manpower Administration stated, "As the only institution in the country that examines health status using the same procedures and standards to determine physical fitness grades required for fulfilling military service obligations, we hold health data for the entire male population of South Korea. We will go beyond using this vast data for physical grade assessments and utilize it as foundational material for national youth health policies." (병무청은 “병역의무 이행에 필요한 신체 등급 판정을 위해 동일한 절차와 기준으로 건강 상태를 검사하는 국내 유일 기관으로 대한민국 남성 전체의 건강 데이터를 보유하고 있다. 이런 방대한 데이터를 신체등급 판정에 그치지 않고 국가 청년 건강정책의 기초자료로 활용하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The "Health Indicators of Korean 19-Year-Old Men" will be published regularly every year through the Korean Statistical Information Service (KOSIS) and the Public Data Portal. If raw data is requested for purposes such as research, it will be made available after de-identifying personal information through the Public Data Portal and data safe zones. (‘한국인 19세 남성 건강지표’는 국가통계포털(KOSIS)과 공공데이터포털을 통해 매년 정기적으로 공개될 예정이다. 연구 등의 목적으로 원시자료 개방을 요청할 경우 개인정보를 비식별화한 후 공공데이터 포털과 데이터 안심구역을 통해 개방할 예정이다.)

Kwon Hyuk-chul Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: "Yoon Yong-geun-Jung Mong-gyu Text Messages Due to Personal Friendship... Not a Matter for Apology" (국힘 “윤용근-정몽규 문자, 개인적 친분 때문…사과할 일은 아냐”)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties showed sharply contrasting positions over a text message sent by People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Yong-geun to former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu, who appeared as a witness at the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee hearing on the Korea Football Association on the 30th, which read, "I should have taken better care of you... I'm sorry." While the Democratic Party of Korea criticized it as "an outrageous collusion," the People Power Party dismissed it, saying, "It's not something to apologize for." <<> Choi Eun-seok, the People Power Party's chief deputy floor spokesperson, met with reporters after a floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly on the 31st and responded to questions about the text message, saying, "I view it as a casual exchange of opinions due to personal friendship," and added, "There was no particular discussion about it within the party." <<> He continued, "Personally, the issue arose from looking at a cell phone on the floor of the plenary session, and I don't think it's something (Yoon) needs to apologize for, but he seems to be feeling a bit uncomfortable himself." <<> When asked, "What exactly does 'casually exchanging opinions' mean?" Spokesperson Choi replied, "I didn't ask in detail. It was due to Yoon's personal circumstances." He added, "If lawmakers know someone (appearing as a witness) at a hearing or standing committee meeting, isn't it possible to reach out individually? Personally, there may be people with that kind of stance." <<> When asked, "Doesn't the party view this matter seriously?" Spokesperson Choi answered, "Yes." <<> In contrast, the Democratic Party issued a statement saying, "We strongly condemn lawmaker Yoon and former President Jung for mocking the hearing." Lee Ju-hee, the Democratic Party's deputy floor spokesperson, said in a written briefing released that day, "A lawmaker who should be uncovering the truth and a witness who should be held accountable engaged in an outrageous collusion in the middle of the hearing room, 'taking care of' each other and worrying about each other's well-being." She added, "This collusion scandal is an incident that, far from cutting off the absurdities in the football world, fully exposes the bare face of politics busy protecting and covering up corruption." <<> Earlier, on the 30th, the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee held a hearing to investigate problems in the overall operation of the Korea Football Association, which came to light after the national football team's elimination from the round of 32 at the 2026 North and Central America World Cup, and summoned former head coach Hong Myung-bo and former President Jung as witnesses. At 1:50 p.m. that same day, Yoon, a committee member, sent a text message to Jung that read, "Chairman, this is People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Yong-geun. I was contacted by senior Jung yesterday. I should have taken better care of you... I'm sorry." Five minutes later, Jung replied, "Thank you for your concern. I will greet you in a different setting, not a place like this. From Jung Mong-gyu." <<> In response, Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee Chairperson Lee Jae-jung pressed Jung, asking, "During the preparation for the hearing, did you contact hearing committee members to lobby them?" Jung replied, "I asked what questions might be asked and whether there was anything I needed to prepare in advance," and apologized, saying, "If that was a problem, I feel quite sorry about it." <<> Yoon explained, "There was absolutely nothing (of value) exchanged, and I do not at all think that this made the hearing problematic or inadequate." <<> Reporter Jeon Kwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (윤용근 국민의힘 의원이 30일 국회 문화체육관광위원회의 대한축구협회 청문회 증인으로 출석한 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장에게 “더 잘 배려해 드려야 하는데…송구합니다”라는 문자를 보낸 것을 두고 여야는 상반된 입장을 드러냈다. 더불어민주당에서는 “기막힌 짬짜미”라고 비판했지만, 국민의힘은 “사과할 일은 아니”라고 일축했다.)

item.title: US Drone's 'Unauthorized Flight' Nearly Shot Down... Military Says "No Notice Given" (격추할 뻔한, 미군 무인기 ‘무단 비행’…군 “통보 없었다”)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) Readiness Inspection Office stated on the 31st that it will visit the Army's 1st Corps to review the overall situation regarding the incident the previous day, when a US military drone in the northern Gyeonggi region was perceived as an initial North Korean drone. Military authorities responded to reports that the US military had notified South Korean forces in advance of the drone flight plan, saying, "They did not notify us of the flight plan." (합동참모본부(합참) 전비태세검열실이 전날 경기 북부 지역에서 주한미군 무인기를 초기 북한 무인기로 인지한 상황과 관련해 육군 제1군단을 방문해 전반적인 사안을 확인할 예정이라고 31일 밝혔다. 군당국은 미군이 우리 군에 사전 무인기 비행 계획을 통보했다는 보도에 대해 “비행 계획을 통보한 것은 아니다”고 전했다.)

The South Korean military, judging that a US drone training in the civilian control line (CCL) area of northern Gyeonggi the previous afternoon could have been a North Korean drone infiltration, activated air defense posture and prepared for a possible shootdown. While US Forces Korea maintains that they had shared the drone's flight plan with the South Korean military in advance, South Korean military authorities are known to hold the position that they never approved it. This has raised speculation about potential gaps in information sharing between the South Korean and US military authorities. (한국군은 전날 오후 경기 북부 민간인출입통제선(민통선) 지역에서 훈련하던 미군 무인기를 북한 무인기 침투일 가능성이 있다고 판단해 방공태세를 갖추고 격추까지 대비했다. 주한미군 쪽은 해당 무인기의 비행 계획을 미리 한국군에 공유했다는 입장이지만, 우리 군 당국은 이를 승인한 적 없다는 입장인 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 한미 군 당국 간 정보공유에 빈틈이 있는 것 아니냐는 관측이 제기됐다.)

A Ministry of National Defense official, responding to some reports that "the US military notified our military of the training plan in advance and, as the training approached, also sent an official document regarding the drone," said, "The US military notified us of this training plan, but they did not notify us of the drone flight plan." A JCS official also stated, "The drone flight was never approved." At the time, the ROK Marine Corps 1st Division and the US Marine Corps were conducting the annual Korea Marine Exercise Program (KMEP), a regular combined training exercise. (국방부 관계자는 ‘미군은 우리 군에 사전에 훈련 계획을 통보했고, 훈련이 임박해서는 무인기 관련 공문도 보냈다’는 일부 보도에 대해 “미군이 이번 훈련계획을 통보했고, 무인기 비행 계획을 통보한 것은 아니다”고 말했다. 합참 관계자도 “무인기 비행이 승인된 사실이 없다”고 말했다. 당시 한국 해병대 1사단과 미 해병대는 매년 정기 훈련인 한미 해병대 연합훈련(KMEP)을 하고 있었다.)

A US Forces Korea official stated, "This incident occurred during a ROK-US combined training exercise at a US military training site in Paju," adding, "The drone in question was operated by the 3rd Battalion, 7th Marine Regiment, which is forward-deployed with the 4th Marine Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, as part of the US Marine Corps unit deployment program." He further explained, "We are currently confirming the circumstances and details of the situation, including coordination procedures, and the US is conducting its own investigation while closely cooperating with the South Korean military to verify the facts." The US 3rd Marine Division is normally stationed in Okinawa, Japan. (주한미군 관계자는 “해당 사안은 파주 소재 미군 훈련장에서 실시된 한미 연합훈련 중 발생한 것”이라며 “해당 무인기는 미 해병대 부대 전개프로그램의 일환으로 미 해병대 제3해병사단 제4해병연대와 함께 전진 배치 중인 제7해병연대 제3대대가 운용한 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이어 “현재 협조 절차를 포함한 당시 상황과 경위를 확인 중이고, 미국도 자체 조사를 진행하는 한편, 사실관계 확인을 위해 한국군과 긴밀히 협조하고 있다”고 설명했다. 평소 미 해병대 3사단은 일본 오키나와에 주둔하고 있다.)

The JCS plans to review the entire communication and coordination process, including whether the US military requested drone flight coordination from the 1st Corps, a unit under South Korean operational control, and whether the information was properly relayed to the Ground Operations Command, which holds approval authority. (합참은 미군이 한국군 관할 부대인 1군단에 무인기 비행 협조를 요청했는지, 이후 1군단이 승인권이 있는 지상작전사령부까지 관련 내용이 제대로 전달됐는지 등 소통·협조 절차 전반을 살펴볼 방침이다.)

Previously, the day before, an "unidentified aircraft" was detected by the Army 1st Corps' Thermal Observation Device (TOD) and local air defense radar in the area south of the General Outpost (GOP) line in northern Gyeonggi. This area is a front-line zone, and drone flights in the area require prior approval from the Army Ground Operations Commander or the Air Force Operations Commander. When an unidentified aircraft without flight approval was detected, 'Durumi,' a readiness posture prepared for North Korean drone infiltration, was issued. Subsequently, field units strengthened their surveillance posture, alert posture, firepower standby posture, and air defense weapon posture. (앞서 전날 경기 북부 일반전초(GOP) 이남 지역에서 ‘미확인 비행체’가 육군 1군단의 열상감시장비(TOD)와 국지방공레이더에 포착됐다. 해당 지역은 최전방 지대로, 해당 지역 무인기 비행은 육군 지상작전사령관이나 공군작전사령관의 사전 승인을 받아야 한다. 비행승인 사실이 없는 미확인 비행체가 포착되자 북한 무인기 침투 등에 대비하는 준비태세인 ‘두루미'가 발령됐다. 이후 현장 부대의 감시형태·경계태세·화력대기태세·방공무기태세도 강화했다.)

When an unidentified flying object is detected, military authorities respond in stages: detection-identification-tracking-interception/shootdown. Although a situation could have escalated to attacking US forces during the combined training, the drone was identified as a US military drone during the identification stage, given that its shape differed from North Korean drones and its flight trajectory was centered around the US military training site in Paju, Gyeonggi, so no shootdown measures such as firing were taken. The Story shooting range, where the drone took off and landed, is a US military training site in a front-line area located approximately 3.7 km south of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). (군 당국은 미확인비행물체가 포착되면 탐지-식별-추적-차단·격추 등 단계적으로 대응한다. 자칫 연합훈련 중인 미군 전력을 공격하는 상황까지 벌어질 뻔했지만 당시 무인기 형상이 북한 무인기와 다르고 경기 파주 미군 훈련장 중심으로 이뤄진 비행 궤적 등으로 미뤄 식별 단계에서 미군 무인기로 확인돼, 발포 등 격추 조처는 없었다. 해당 무인기가 이·착륙한 스토리 사격장은 군사분계선(MDL)으로부터 약 3.7㎞ 아래에 이는 최전방 지역에 있는 미군 훈련장이다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Recommends Attorney Choi Gil-soo as Special Inspector Candidate for Presidential Relatives (민주, ‘대통령 친족 감찰’ 특별감찰관 후보에 최길수 변호사 추천)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea recommended attorney Choi Gil-soo (60) as a candidate for special inspector on the 31st. The special inspector is an independent body that inspects misconduct by the president's spouse, relatives within fourth-degree consanguinity, and public officials at or above the level of senior presidential secretary in the presidential office. (더불어민주당은 31일 특별감찰관 후보로 최길수 변호사(60)를 추천했다. 특별감찰관은 대통령의 배우자와 4촌 이내 친족, 대통령비서실 수석비서관급 이상 공직자의 비위행위를 감찰하는 독립기관이다.)

Han Byung-do, acting leader of the Democratic Party and floor leader, announced this at a press briefing at the National Assembly on the same day, introducing Choi as "a specialist in inspections who served as chief prosecutor of the special investigations division at the Gwangju District Prosecutors' Office, head of the Andong branch of the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office, and worked in the inspection division of the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office." Han said, "Choi was recommended as a special inspector candidate in 2019 during the Moon Jae-in administration when the Bareunmirae Party, then the opposition, nominated him in consultations among the three negotiating parties," adding, "We judged him to be the right person to carry out his duties independently from the public's perspective without bias toward any camp." (한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 기자간담회를 열고 이같이 밝히고 “최 변호사는 광주지검 특수부장 검사, 대구지검 안동지청장을 역임했고, 서울고검 감찰부에서 근무한 감찰 분야 전문가”라고 소개했다. 한 원내대표는 “최 변호사는 2019년 문재인 정부 당시 야당이었던 바른미래당이 교섭단체 3당의 특별감찰관 후보 협의에서 추천한 인사”라며 “진영에 치우치지 않고 국민 눈높이에서 독립적으로 직무를 수행할 적임자라고 판단했다”고 했다.)

The special inspector is appointed after the National Assembly recommends three candidates, the president designates one of them, and the candidate undergoes a parliamentary confirmation hearing. A special inspector candidate must have at least 15 years of experience as a judge, prosecutor, or attorney, and the term of office is three years. Earlier, in April, the People Power Party recommended attorney Kang Ji-sik, so each of the ruling and opposition parties has recommended one candidate. The Democratic Party plans to request a recommendation from the Korean Bar Association at a later date. (특별감찰관은 국회가 3명의 후보를 추천하면 대통령이 이 가운데 1명을 지명하고, 국회 인사청문회 절차를 거쳐 임명된다. 특별감찰관 후보는 15년 이상의 판사·검사·변호사 경력이 있어야 하고 임기는 3년이다. 앞서 지난 4월 국민의힘이 강지식 변호사를 추천해 여야가 1명씩 추천한 상황이라, 민주당은 추후 대한변호사협회에 특별감찰관 추천을 요청할 계획이다.)

Previously, on April 19, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik of the presidential office stated, "President Lee Jae-myung has once again requested that the National Assembly begin the appointment process for a special inspector to establish discipline in the public service and enhance transparency in state affairs," and called for the National Assembly to commence its recommendation process. (앞서, 강훈식 청와대비서실장은 지난 4월19일 “이재명 대통령은 공직기강을 확립하고 국정 운영의 투명성을 제고하기 위해 국회가 특별감찰관 임명 절차를 개시해줄 것을 다시 한 번 요청했다”고 밝히고 국회의 추천절차 개시를 요구한 바 있다.)

The special inspector position was established in June 2014 as a campaign pledge of former President Park Geun-hye. Attorney Lee Seok-soo was appointed as the first special inspector in March 2015, but resigned in September of the following year after clashing with the administration during the inspection of Woo Byung-woo, then senior presidential secretary for civil affairs. Since then, no special inspector was recommended or appointed during the tenures of former Presidents Moon Jae-in and Yoon Suk-yeol. (특별감찰관은 2014년 6월 박근혜 전 대통령의 공약으로 신설됐고, 2015년 3월 이석수 변호사가 첫 특별감찰관으로 임명됐으나 우병우 청와대 민정수석 감찰 과정 등에서 정권과 갈등을 겪다 이듬해 9월 사직했다. 이후 문재인·윤석열 전 대통령 때에는 특별감찰관 추천과 임명이 아예 이뤄지지 않았다.)

Lee Ji-eun, staff reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party to File Jurisdiction Dispute and Constitutional Petitions Over Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Rights (국힘, ‘검사 보완수사권’ 폐지에 “권한쟁의·헌법소원 심판 청구”)
item.description:
The People Power Party announced on the 31st that it will file a jurisdiction dispute adjudication and a constitutional complaint with the Constitutional Court regarding the Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill, expected to be processed at the National Assembly plenary session in the afternoon, which fully abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights. (국민의힘이 31일 오후 국회 본회의에서 처리될 것으로 전망되는 ‘검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 헌법재판소에 권한쟁의심판과 헌법소원심판을 청구하겠다는 입장을 밝혔다.)

Park Choong-kwon, the People Power Party's senior spokesperson, told reporters at the National Assembly that day, "Before the Criminal Procedure Act (amendment) was even brought to the plenary session, we had stated that our party would respond with every means and method, including a filibuster." He added, "We will also proceed with a jurisdiction dispute (adjudication) and a constitutional complaint in the future." The spokesperson further stated, "We will make every effort to fully inform the public of the various side effects that will emerge once this law takes effect, to shape public opinion and ensure it can be properly reversed." <<> A jurisdiction dispute adjudication is a system in which the Constitutional Court rules when a conflict arises among state institutions regarding the existence or scope of their authority under the Constitution. A constitutional complaint is a system through which citizens whose fundamental rights guaranteed by the Constitution have been violated by the exercise or non-exercise of state public power directly seek remedy from the Constitutional Court. <<> The Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill, scheduled for a vote around 4 p.m. that day, is centered on completely abolishing prosecutors' direct investigative authority and unifying investigative authority under judicial police officers. The purpose is to fully separate investigation from prosecution. Grounds for dismissal of indictment, such as "when an indictment is filed based on a serious illegal investigation" and "when an indictment is filed in clear deviation from prosecutorial discretion," were also added. <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (박충권 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “형사소송법 (개정안)이 본회의에 부의되기 전부터 우리 당에서는 필리버스터를 포함한 모든 수단과 방법으로 대응하겠다고 말했다”며 “앞으로 권한쟁의(심판), 헌법소원도 진행할 것”이라고 말했다. 박 대변인은 “이 법이 시행되면 나타날 여러 부작용을 국민들께 충분히 알려서 여론을 형성하고, 다시 제대로 되돌릴 수 있도록 모든 노력을 다하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Joint Chiefs Order GP·GOP Units to "Keep Machine Guns Loaded with Live Rounds" (합참, GP·GOP에 “기관총 실탄 끼운 상태 유지” 명령)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced on the 31st that, after it was revealed the Army's 1st Corps had conducted guard operations without loading ammunition into firearms, they issued a fragmentary order to frontline guard units to keep crew-served weapons (firearms operated by a team of two or more) in a loaded state (ammunition inserted into the weapon, ready to fire). A fragmentary order is a brief operational command used to notify changes in a unit's mission or tactical situation, and is issued partially, only to the applicable units. (합동참모본부(합참)는 육군 1군단이 탄알을 총기에 끼우지 않고 경계 작전을 편 사실이 알려지자 최전방 경계작전 부대에 공용화기(2명 이상이 조를 구성하여 조작하는 화기)는 삽탄(총기에 탄알을 끼워 넣어 발사할 수 있는 상태로 준비) 상태를 유지하라는 단편명령을 내렸다고 31일 밝혔다. 단평명령은 부대의 임무 또는 전술 상황의 변경을 알리는 데 사용하는 간략한 작전 명령으로, 해당하는 부대에 한하여 부분적으로 하달하는 명령이다.)

The JCS stated that the Army's Ground Operations Command had issued this directive the previous day to frontline corps conducting guard operations at General Outposts (GOP) and Guard Posts (GP). Since the previous day, the Army Ground Operations Command has been inspecting the guard operations of the 1st Corps and five frontline corps, including the Capital, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th Corps. (육군 지상작전사령부는 전날 일반전초(GOP)와 최전방 소초(GP) 경계작전을 수행하는 전방 군단에 이 같은 지침을 하달했다고 합참이 전했다. 육군 지상작전사령부는 전날부터 1군단과 수도·2·3·5군단 등 5개 전방군단의 경계작전 실태를 점검하고 있다.)

The 1st Corps, which oversees the western front, has since the first half of this year been conducting GP and GOP guard operations without loading live rounds into crew-served weapons such as the K6 heavy machine gun and the K4 high-velocity grenade launcher, keeping the ammunition beside the firearms instead. While loading ammunition is the principle during frontline unit guard operations, the 1st Corps is known to have changed its guard operation guidelines at the corps commander's discretion to prevent accidental discharges. (서부전선을 관할하는 1군단은 올해 상반기부터 지피, 지오피 경계작전에서 케이(K)6 중기관총, 케이(K)4 고속유탄발사기 등 공용화기에 실탄을 끼우지 않고 탄약을 총기 옆에 두고 근무하고 있다. 최전방부대 경계작전 때는 삽탄이 원칙이지만, 1군단은 오발 사고를 예방하기 위해 군단장 재량으로 경계작전 지침을 바꾼 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Bill to abolish supplementary investigation rights passes National Assembly plenary session ([속보] ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 형사소송법 개정안, 국회 본회의 통과)
item.description:
The National Assembly passed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act at a plenary session on the 31st that completely abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights. As a result, prosecutors' investigative powers will be eliminated for the first time in 78 years. (국회가 31일 검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안을 본회의에서 의결했다. 이로써 검찰의 수사권은 78년 만에 사라지게 된다.)

In a vote held immediately after the filibuster (unlimited debate) that had been underway since the bill was introduced the previous day concluded, the bill passed with 175 votes in favor, 2 against, and 1 abstention out of 178 lawmakers present. The People Power Party did not participate in the vote. (전날부터 법안 상정 뒤 진행된 필리버스터(무제한 토론)가 종료된 직후 이뤄진 표결에서 재석의원 178명에 찬성 175명, 반대 2명, 기권 1명으로 법안이 가결됐다. 국민의힘은 표결에 참석하지 않았다.)

item.title: [Breaking] National Assembly bill to shorten fast-track period from 330 to 90 days tabled at plenary session ([속보] ‘패스트트랙 기간 330→90일’ 국회법 개정안 본회의 상정)
item.description:
The National Assembly on the 31st tabled at a plenary session a revision to the National Assembly Act centered on "shortening the fast-track (expedited processing) period." The bill seeks to reduce the review period for bills designated as expedited items from a maximum of 330 days to a maximum of 90 days. (국회는 31일 ‘패스스트랙(신속처리안건) 기간 단축’을 뼈대로 한 국회법 개정안을 본회의에 상정했다. 이 법안은 신속처리안건으로 지정된 법안의 심사기간을 최장 330일에서 최장 90일로 줄이는 내용을 담고 있다.)

As the People Power Party, which opposes the bill, has launched a filibuster (unlimited debate), the vote is expected to take place during the August extraordinary session. (이 법안에 반대하는 국민의힘이 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 나서 표결은 8월 임시국회에서 이뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: North Korean Home Village Women's Football Team Coach Tells Suwon FC, "Never Seen a Team of This High Level" (우승한 북 내고향 축구팀 감독, 수원FC에 “이런 높은 수준의 팀은 처음”)
item.description:
Ri Yu-il, the head coach who led North Korea's Home Village Women's Football Team (Naegohyang) to victory in the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League (AWCL), cited the semifinal match against Suwon FC Women held in Suwon on May 20 as the "biggest hurdle" on the road to the title. (북한 내고향여자축구단(내고향)을 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자챔피언스리그(AWCL) 우승으로 이끈 리유일 책임감독이 지난 5월20일 수원에서 열린 수원에프시(FC)위민과의 준결승 경기를 우승의 “최대 고비”로 꼽았다.)

In an interview with the Chongryon-affiliated newspaper Chosun Sinbo, published on the 31st, Coach Ri said, "The match that stands out most in my memory is the final, but the toughest hurdle was definitely the semifinal." He noted that his team had never lost in four matches against South Korean teams, saying of Suwon FC Women, "This was the first time we faced a team of such a high level. Moreover, the match venue was the opponent's home stadium." ( 리 감독은 31일 공개된 재일조선인총연합회(총련) 기관지 조선신보와 인터뷰에서 “인상에 가장 남는 경기는 결승 경기 같으면서도 제일 힘든 고비는 바로 준결승 경기였다”고 말했다. 리 감독은 지금까지 한국팀과 4차례 경기에서 한 차례도 패한 적이 없다며 수원에프시위민에 대해 “이번처럼 높은 수준의 팀은 처음이었다. 더욱이 경기 장소도 상대팀의 본거지 경기장이었다”고 말했다.)

In the semifinal held at Suwon World Cup Stadium under heavy rain, Naegohyang defeated Suwon FC Women 2-1 to advance to the final. In the final, Naegohyang beat Japan's Tokyo Verdy 1-0 to claim the championship. ( 당시 폭우가 내리는 수원종합운동장에서 열린 대회 준결승에서 내고향은 수원에프시위민을 2-1로 이기고 결승에 진출했다. 내고향은 결승에서 일본의 도쿄 베르디를 1-0으로 꺾고 우승했다.)

He said, "In any tournament, the toughest opponent is the host country's team. Our players lack international match experience. So we anticipated various scenarios and prepared extensively, training hard. The effort we put into preparation paid off in the actual matches." ( 그는 “어떤 경기에서나 제일 어려운 상대는 주최국팀”이라며 “우리 선수들은 국제경기 경험이 부족하다. 그래서 여러가지 정황을 예견해서 준비를 많이 했고 훈련도 많이 했다. 품 들여 준비한 것이 실지 경기에서 효과를 보았다”고 말했다.)

When asked if there were any coaches in the international football world who influenced him, Coach Ri said, "I participated in overseas training sessions and met world-renowned coaches including Jürgen Klopp and Guus Hiddink, and exchanged experiential insights with them." He revealed his exchanges with Hiddink, who led the 2002 World Cup semifinal run, and Klopp, who recently took charge of the German national team. He added that because his mother engaged in foreign affairs work, he was able to learn foreign languages from a young age, saying, "I could converse comfortably in foreign languages with world-famous coaches like Guus Hiddink and Pep Guardiola." (리 감독은 국제 축구계에서 영향을 받은 감독이 있느냐는 질문에 “해외강습에 참가하여 위르겐 클롭, 거스 히딩크를 비롯한 세계적으로 이름난 감독들을 만나보고 경험적인 이야기도 나누었다”며 2002 월드컵 4강을 이끈 히딩크 감독, 최근 독일 국가대표팀 감독을 맡은 클롭과의 교류 경험을 공개했다. 그는 어머니가 대외사업을 벌인 덕에 어릴 때부터 외국어를 배울 수 있었다며 “거스 히딩크나 펩 과르디올라와 같은 세계적으로 이름난 감독들과 외국어로 편하게 대할 수 있었다”고 말했다.)

Regarding future goals, Coach Ri said, "We must maintain our status as a strong Asian team and break through the qualifiers for the FIFA 2028 Club World Cup starting in October, advancing to the final stage. If we achieve that, it would be a great step forward not only for the Naegohyang team but also for our (North Korean) football community and Asian football as a whole." ( 리 감독은 앞으로의 목표에 대해 “아시아의 강팀으로서 지위를 유지하면서 10월부터 진행되는 국제축구연맹(FIFA) 2028 클럽월드컵 예선을 돌파해 결승 단계 경기까지 가야 한다”며 “그렇게 된다면 내고향팀은 물론 우리(북한) 축구계나 아시아축구계에 있어서도 큰 전진”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Kwon Hyuk-chul Reporter nura@hani.co.kr ( 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Special inspector general may be appointed after 10 years… Candidate recommended a year after President Lee's request (10년 만에 특별감찰관 나오나…이 대통령 요청 1년 만에 후보 추천)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 31st recommended Choi Gil-su, a lawyer and former prosecutor, as a candidate for special inspector general, who is responsible for inspecting misconduct by the president's relatives and others with special relationships to the president. This comes about a year after President Lee Jae-myung announced in July of last year that he would push for the appointment of a special inspector general. (더불어민주당은 31일 대통령 친인척 등 대통령과 특수한 관계에 있는 사람에 대한 감찰을 담당하는 특별감찰관 후보로 검사 출신인 최길수 변호사를 추천했다. 지난해 7월 이재명 대통령이 특별감찰관 임명을 추진하겠다고 밝힌 지 약 1년 만이다.)

Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, held a press briefing at the National Assembly that day and said, "Our government has expressed its intention to appoint someone, but the National Assembly has not made a recommendation, leaving the system virtually stalled," adding, "President Lee Jae-myung has made clear his determination not to leave this vacancy unattended any longer. The Democratic Party will respond responsibly to the president's decision to prove the transparency of power through institutions, not words." (한병도 민주당 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 기자간담회를 열어 “그동안 우리 정부는 임명 의지를 밝혔지만 국회의 후보 추천이 이뤄지지 않아 제도가 사실상 멈춘 상태”라며 “이재명 대통령은 이런 공백을 더 방치하지 않겠다는 의지를 분명히 했다. 권력의 투명도를 말이 아닌 제도로 증명하겠다는 대통령 결단에 민주당이 책임 있게 화답하겠다”고 말했다.)

The special inspector general is a position that inspects misconduct by the president's spouse, relatives within the fourth degree of kinship, and public officials at or above the rank of senior presidential secretary in the presidential office. Under the Special Inspector General Act, when the National Assembly recommends three candidates from among legal professionals with at least 15 years of experience as judges, prosecutors, or lawyers, the president must designate one of them as special inspector general within three days. The candidate is finally appointed after going through a confirmation hearing. (특별감찰관은 대통령의 배우자와 4촌 이내 친족, 대통령비서실의 수석비서관 이상의 공무원의 비위행위를 감찰하는 자리다. 특별감찰관법에 따라 국회가 15년 이상 판·검사나 변호사 활동을 한 법조인 가운데 3명을 후보로 추천하면, 대통령은 사흘 안에 후보 중 1명을 특별감찰관으로 지명해야 한다. 후보자는 인사청문회를 거쳐 최종 임명된다.)

Choi, recommended as a candidate by the Democratic Party that day, passed the 33rd bar examination in 1991, was appointed as a prosecutor at the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office in 1997, and served as deputy chief prosecutor of the Special Investigation Division 3 at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, chief prosecutor of the Special Investigation Division at the Gwangju District Prosecutors' Office, and chief of the Andong Branch of the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office. From 2016 until his resignation in August 2017, he also worked at the inspection division of the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office. In 2019, he was also recommended as a special inspector general candidate by the Bareunmirae Party. Floor Leader Han said at the briefing that day, "We judged him to be the right person to independently carry out the duties of special inspector general from the perspective of the people, without leaning toward any camp." (이날 민주당이 후보로 추천한 최 변호사는 1991년 33회 사법시험에 합격한 뒤 1997년 대구지검 검사로 임용돼 서울중앙지검 특수3부 부부장 검사, 광주지검 특수부장 검사, 대구지검 안동지청장을 거쳤다. 2016년부터 2017년 8월 퇴진 전까진 서울고검 감찰부에서도 일했다. 또 지난 2019년엔 바른미래당이 특별감찰관 후보로 추천한 인사이기도 하다. 한 원내대표는 “진영에 치우치지 않고 국민 눈높이에서 독립적으로 특별감찰관직을 수행할 적임자라고 판단했다”고 이날 간담회에서 말했다.)

Floor Leader Han also said, "We aim to complete the confirmation hearing process for the special inspector general candidate by August." The People Power Party already internally selected Kang Ji-sik, a lawyer and former prosecutor, as its candidate for the opposition party's share in April. The Democratic Party stated that it would request a recommendation from the Korean Bar Association for the remaining one candidate besides the one each from the ruling and opposition parties. (한 원내대표는 “(특별감찰관 후보) 인사청문 절차까지 8월 안에 (마치는 것을) 목표로 하겠다”고도 말했다. 국민의힘은 이미 지난 4월 야당 몫 후보로 검사 출신인 강지식 변호사를 내정해둔 상태다. 여야 추천 후보 각 1명 외 나머지 1명에 대해선 대한변호사협회에 추천을 요청하겠다고 민주당은 밝혔다.)

If the final appointment is completed after the candidate recommendation and confirmation hearing, it will mark the second special inspector general in history, about 10 years after 2016. The special inspector general position was introduced during the Park Geun-hye administration but had remained vacant since the resignation of the first special inspector general, Lee Seok-su, in 2016. (후보 추천과 청문회를 거쳐 최종 임명이 완료되면, 지난 2016년 이후 약 10년 만에 역대 두번째 특별감찰관이 탄생하게 된다. 특별감찰관은 박근혜 정부 시절 도입된 뒤 2016년 이석수 초대 특별감찰관 사퇴 후 줄곧 공석이었다.)

Political circles are paying attention to the "timing" of the Democratic Party's move to recommend a special inspector general candidate. President Lee had repeatedly requested the National Assembly to recommend candidates for special inspector general since July of last year, shortly after his inauguration, but the ruling party had not made a recommendation. After President Lee again requested on April 19 that "the National Assembly begin the appointment process," the ruling and opposition floor leaders held a lunch meeting the next day to discuss the appointment process, but related procedures were subsequently suspended. (정치권에서는 민주당이 특별감찰관 후보 추천에 나선 ‘시점’을 주목하고 있다. 이 대통령은 취임 직후인 지난해 7월부터 국회에 특별감찰관 후보 추천을 여러차례 요청해왔지만, 여당 후보 추천은 이뤄지지 않았다. 이 대통령이 지난 4월19일 “국회가 임명 절차를 개시해달라”고 재차 요청한 뒤, 이튿날 여야 원내지도부가 오찬 회동을 통해 임명 절차 관련 협의를 하기도 했지만 이후 관련 절차는 중단돼 있었다.)

Accordingly, there are views that the government and ruling party belatedly moved to recommend a special inspector general candidate as a card to shift the narrative amid a barrage of bad news, such as the controversy over "presidential term extension via constitutional amendment" sparked by National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik's recent remarks, or the controversy over single-stock leveraged products linked to the sharp stock market decline. (이에 최근 조정식 국회의장 발언으로 불거진 ‘현직 대통령 연임 개헌’ 논란이나 증시 급락과 연동된 단일종목 레버리지 상품 논란 등 쏟아지는 악재에 정부·여당이 국면 전환용 카드로 뒤늦게 특별감찰관 후보 추천에 나선 것 아니냐는 시선도 있다.)

Jeong Jeom-sik, the People Power Party's floor leader, told reporters that day, "For a year, the presidential office demanded recommendations from the National Assembly while the Democratic Party refused to respond—a double play that deceived the people," adding, "The Democratic Party's belated move to make a recommendation feels like 'better late than never,' and I also suspect it may be an attempt to divert attention to quell public anger over the abolition of supplementary investigation powers." However, Floor Leader Jeong added, "Still, I welcome the Democratic Party's decision to make a recommendation now. We will strive to ensure the special inspector general is appointed promptly." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 기자들에게 “1년간 청와대는 국회에 추천을 요구하고, 민주당이 추천에 응하지 않는 이중플레이로 국민을 기만했다”며 “민주당이 이제야 추천에 나선 건 만시지탄의 느낌이 있고 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 분노 여론을 잠재우기 위해 관심을 돌리려는 것 아니냐는 의구심도 든다”고 했다. 다만 정 원내대표는 “이제라도 (민주당이) 추천에 나선 건 환영한다. 특별감찰관이 신속하게 임명될 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

Seemingly aware of such criticism, Floor Leader Han said, "We were preparing to make the candidate recommendation after the formation of the second-half National Assembly leadership. The leadership structure was recently completed, and we judged that now is the right time to finish all procedures before the regular session in September." (이러한 비판을 의식한듯 한 원내대표는 “후반기 국회 원구성 이후 (후보 추천을 하려고) 준비하고 있었다. 얼마 전에 원구성이 마무리됐고 9월 정기국회 전 절차를 마무리하려면 지금이 적절하다고 판단했다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Even if we fall behind in the 'first round,' we will ultimately win"... Jeong Cheong-rae: "The trend will become the mainstream" (김민석 “‘1차전’ 열세여도 결국 이길 것”…정청래 “추세가 대세 될 것”)
item.description:
The provincial tours for the August 17 national convention to elect the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea will take place on the 1st of next month in the Chungcheong region and on the 2nd in Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang. A day before the "first round," on the 31st, candidate Kim Min-seok acknowledged a "7-percentage-point deficit" and vowed to turn the tide, while candidate Jeong Cheong-rae expressed confidence in victory, saying, "The summit of victory has become a reality." (더불어민주당 당대표를 선출하기 위한 8·17 전당대회 순회경선이 다음달 1일 충청권, 2일 부산·울산·경남에서 진행된다. ‘1차전’을 하루 앞둔 31일, 김민석 후보는 ‘7%포인트 열세’를 인정하며 역전을 다짐했고, 정청래 후보는 “승리의 고지가 현실화됐다”고 승리를 자신했다.)

On X (formerly Twitter) that day, Kim said, "I have cleanly accepted the first round in Chungcheong, the opponent's home turf, and Busan, the opponent's organizational base, and have accepted the incumbent candidate's early advantages," adding, "If we can limit the deficit to at most 7 percentage points in the first round, we will ultimately win in the combined first-choice votes from subsequent regions, and even if we exceed minus 7 percentage points, we will bounce back like a spring in supporter polls." (김 후보는 이날 엑스(X)에 “저는 상대 연고지인 충청, 상대 조직기반인 부산의 1차전을 깔끔히 받아들이고, 연임 후보의 초반 기득권을 수용했다”라며 “1차전에서 최대 7%(포인트) 마이너스(열세)까지만 막아내면, 결국 후속 지역의 1순위표 종합에서 이길 것이고, 마이너스 7%(포인트)를 넘겨도 지지층 여론조사에서 용수철처럼 막아낼 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

This is effectively an admission of being at a disadvantage ahead of the Chungcheong and Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang provincial tours. Appearing on the YouTube show "Jang Yoon-seon's Convenience Store Report" that day, Kim said, "In the Chungcheong region, where most see former leader Jeong Cheong-rae as having the advantage, and then in Busan and other areas where former leader Jeong's close associates hold strong local organizations, there is an influence of organizational strength," adding, "There were objections that having Chungcheong and Busan grouped together in the first week favored one candidate, but I simply accepted it." This was a "underdog strategy" of pointing out that starting the provincial tours in Chungcheong, where Jeong's hometown (Geumsan, South Chungcheong) is located, and in Busan, where local organizational power is solid, favors Jeong and disadvantages him. (이는 충청권, 부·울·경 순회경선을 앞두고 열세를 사실상 인정한 것이다. 김 후보는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘장윤선의 취재편의점’에 출연해 “대부분 정청래 전 대표 쪽이 유리할 것이라고 보는 충청권과 그다음에 정 전 대표의 측근이 (지역) 조직을 세게 가지고 있다는 부산 등지는 조직(력)의 영향이 있다”면서 “1주차에 그렇게 충청과 부산이 같이 포함되는 것이 한 후보에게 유리하다는 문제 제기가 있었는데 저는 그냥 수용했다”고 했다. 정 후보의 고향(충남 금산)이 있는 충청과 지역 조직력이 탄탄한 부산에서 시작하는 순회경선이 정 후보에게 유리하고 자신에게 불리하다며 ‘약자 전략’을 취한 것이다.)

Instead, Kim stressed, "In the first week, we may fall slightly behind, but if the margin stays within 7 percentage points, we will tie in the second week and win big in the third week, securing a stable victory," emphasizing that he would overtake in subsequent regional contests and claim final victory. (대신 김 후보는 “1주차에 저희가 조금 밀릴 것인데, 7%포인트까지 밀리는 정도면 2주차에 비기고 3주차에 대승하면서 안정적으로 이길 것”이라며 이후 다른 지역 순회 경선에서 자신이 역전해 최종 승리를 할 것이라고 강조했다.)

In contrast, Jeong expressed confidence in winning the first round. On Facebook that day, he shared poll results showing himself ahead of Kim and said, "The summit of victory, once seemingly impossible, is now becoming a reality, and the face of victory has begun to peek into view right before our eyes." (반면 정 후보는 1차전 승리를 자신했다. 그는 이날 페이스북에 자신이 김 후보보다 우세하다는 여론조사 결과를 공유하고 “불가능할 것 같았던 승리의 고지가 이제 현실화되고, 승리의 얼굴이 빼꼼하게 눈앞에 나타나기 시작했다”라고 밝혔다.)

Jeong emphasized, "In public opinion, trends matter. Trends become momentum, and momentum becomes the mainstream. Even when hit 3-to-1, I have quietly trusted only the public sentiment and party sentiment. Party sentiment converges with public sentiment, and public sentiment pulls party sentiment along. Public sentiment and party sentiment do not walk separately." This appears to be a remark keeping in mind that in recent polls on suitability for party leader, he leads in "general public opinion" but trails Kim among "Democratic Party supporters." It is interpreted as an assertion that the "public sentiment advantage" will also translate into an advantage in "party sentiment." (정 후보는 “여론은 추세가 중요하다. 추세가 기세가 되고 기세가 대세가 된다”며 “3대1로 때려도 묵묵히 민심·당심만 믿고 왔다. 당심은 민심에 수렴되고 민심은 당심을 견인한다. 민심과 당심은 따로 걷지 않는다”고 강조했다. 최근 당대표 적합도를 묻는 여러 여론조사에서 ‘국민여론’은 우세를 보이고 ‘민주당 지지층’에선 김 후보에게 밀리는 것을 염두에 둔 발언으로 보인다. ‘민심(국민여론) 우세’가 ‘당심(민주당 지지층)우세’로도 연결될 것이라고 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil continued his push into the Honam region for a second straight day, seeking to differentiate himself from the other two candidates. Appearing on KBC Gwangju Broadcasting that day, Song said, "Among the three candidates, I am the only one who has served as a metropolitan mayor and also understands the economy. I have prepared alternatives to actually overcome such economic crises," emphasizing that he is the right person for party leader. The previous day, he visited Haui-do in the special integrated city of South Jeolla-Gwangju, where the birthplace of former President Kim Dae-jung is located. (송영길 후보는 전날에 이어 이날도 호남 공략을 이어가며 두 후보와 차별화를 꾀했다. 송 후보는 이날 케이비시(KBC) 광주방송에 출연해 “세 후보 중에 유일하게 광역자치단체장을 겸했을 뿐만 아니라 경제를 아는 사람 아닌가. 실제 그런 경제적인 위기를 극복해 볼 대안을 준비해 왔다”며 자신이 당대표 적임자라고 강조했다. 그는 전날 김대중 전 대통령의 생가가 위치한 전남광주특별통합시 하의도를 찾았다.)

Jeong Hye-min Reporter jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Blue House Says It Will "Do Its Best for Smooth Implementation" After Passage of Criminal Procedure Act Abolishing Prosecutors' Investigative Powers (청, ‘검사 수사권 폐지’ 형소법 통과에 “차질 없는 시행에 최선 다할 것”)
item.description:
The Blue House said on the 31st regarding the passage of the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which entirely abolishes prosecutors' authority to conduct direct and supplementary investigations, that it "respects the National Assembly's legislative process and final decision." (청와대는 31일 검사의 직접·보완수사 권한을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 국회 본회의를 통과한 것에 대해 “국회의 입법 과정과 최종 판단을 존중한다”고 밝혔다.)

After the amendment passed the plenary session that day, the Blue House issued this position through a notice in the name of Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Seong Ki-hong. The Blue House assessed, "This revision of the Criminal Procedure Act will prevent the monopolization and abuse of power by separating investigation and prosecution, while also raising the level of protection for victims and the human rights of the people, thereby bringing the criminal justice system one step closer to the public." It added, "We will do our best to ensure that this amendment is implemented without disruption in the field and that the public can feel the change in their daily lives." (청와대는 이날 형사소송법 개정안이 본회의를 통과한 뒤 성기홍 홍보소통수석 명의의 공지를 통해 이같은 입장을 냈다. 청와대는 “이번 형사소송법 개정은 수사와 기소의 분리를 통해 권력의 독점과 남용을 막는 한편 피해자와 국민 인권 보호 수준을 높임으로써 형사사법시스템이 국민 곁으로 한 걸음 더 다가서도록 할 것”이라고 평가했다. 이어 “이번 개정안이 현장에서 차질 없이 시행되고, 국민이 삶 속에서 그 변화를 체감할 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

That afternoon, the National Assembly voted on the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which fully abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers, with 175 votes in favor, 2 against, and 1 abstention out of 178 lawmakers present. The People Power Party, which opposed the handling of the bill, did not participate in the vote. As a result, prosecutors' investigative powers will disappear for the first time in 78 years. (국회는 이날 오후 검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안을 재석의원 178명에 찬성 175명, 반대 2명, 기권 1명으로 의결했다. 법안 처리에 반발한 국민의힘은 표결에 참석하지 않았다. 이로써 검찰의 수사권은 78년 만에 사라지게 된다.)

Seo Young-ji, Staff Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Investigative Powers, Full Overhaul of 70-Year Judicial System... Concerns Over 'Lack of Public Consensus' (검사 수사권 완전 폐지, 70여년 사법체계 전면 전환…‘국민적 동의 부족’ 우려도)
item.description:
The revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, which fully abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative powers including supplementary investigation authority, passed the National Assembly plenary session on the 31st led by the ruling party. The revision will take effect on October 2 when the prosecution service is abolished and the Severe Crimes Investigation Office (SCIO) and the Public Prosecution Office (PPO) are launched. The criminal justice system that has continued for over 70 years since the enactment of the Criminal Procedure Act in 1954 faces a major turning point. (검사의 보완수사권을 비롯한 직접 수사 권한을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 31일 여당 주도로 국회 본회의를 통과했다. 법 개정안은 오는 10월2일 검찰청이 폐지되고 중대범죄수사청(중수청)·공소청이 출범하며 시행된다. 1954년 형사소송법 제정 이후 70여년 동안 이어져 온 형사사법체계가 중대한 전환점을 맞게 됐다.)

The ruling party praised the move as "placing prosecutorial power under constitutional and public control," but the opposition fiercely protested, calling it "the end of the rule of law." (여당은 “검찰 권력을 헌법과 국민 통제 아래로 돌렸다”고 자평했지만, 야당은 “법치주의 종말”이라며 거세게 반발했다.)

Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Investigative Powers... Additional Grounds for Dismissal of Indictment Added (검찰 수사권 전면 폐지…공소기각 요건도 추가 )

With the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act passing the plenary session that day, prosecutors will no longer be able to conduct direct investigations or supplementary investigations. Prosecutors will only retain the authority to request supplementary investigations from judicial police officers. (이날 형사소송법 개정안이 본회의를 통과함에 따라, 앞으로 검찰은 직접수사는 물론 보완수사도 할 수 없게 된다. 검사는 사법경찰관에게 보완수사를 요구할 수 있는 권한만 갖는다.)

The Democratic Party faced criticism during the bill's proposal and review process that crime victims and the socially vulnerable would not be properly protected from inadequate police investigations without prosecutors' supplementary investigations, and subsequently added supplementary measures. (민주당은 법안 발의·심사 과정에서 검사의 보완수사가 없을 경우 범죄 피해자·사회적 약자가 경찰의 부실수사에 제대로 구제받을 수 없다는 비판에 직면하자 보완책을 추가했다. )

With the aim of enhancing the effectiveness of prosecutors' authority to request supplementary investigations, police must complete supplementary investigations within one month of receiving such a request and notify the prosecutor. The supplementary investigation period can be extended by up to one month if necessary. (검사의 보완수사요구권의 실효성을 높인다는 취지로 경찰은 보완수사 요구를 받을 경우 1개월 안에 보완수사를 마친 뒤 검사에 알려야 한다. 보완수사 기간은 필요하면 최대 1개월 연장할 수 있다.)

In addition, through future related legislative amendments, all cases involving seven major crimes targeting the socially vulnerable, such as sexual offenses and child abuse, will be sent (referred) to the Public Prosecution Office, and the Severe Crimes Investigation Office will be responsible for supplementary investigations. Supplementary measures also include mandating the recording of all investigation materials in the Criminal Justice Information System (KICS), and granting complainants the right to file objections when police decide not to refer cases. (이와 함께 향후 관련 법률 개정을 통해 성범죄, 아동학대 등 사회적 약자 대상 7대 범죄에 대해서는 모든 사건을 공소청에 보내도록(송치) 하고, 중수청이 보완수사를 담당할 수 있도록 할 예정이다. 수사 전체 자료의 형사사법정보시스템(KICS) 기록 의무화, 경찰 사건 불송치시 고발인의 이의 신청권 부여 등도 보완책으로 포함시켰다.)

The revision also adds grounds for courts to issue dismissal of indictment rulings, which continues to spark controversy. The two added grounds are: when an indictment is filed based on seriously illegal investigations, and when an indictment is filed with a marked departure from prosecutorial discretion. The opposition is criticizing the move as legislation aimed at resolving President Lee Jae-myung's legal risks. (개정안에는 법원이 공소기각 판결을 내릴 수 있는 요건도 추가돼 논란이 이어지고 있다. 추가된 요건은 중대한 위법 수사를 근거로 공소가 제기된 경우, 소추 재량권을 현저히 일탈해 공소가 제기된 경우 등 2개다. 야당은 이재명 대통령의 사법리스크를 해소하기 위한 법 개정 아니냐고 비판하고 있다.)

Before the plenary vote, Han Byung-do, Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the Democratic Party, said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that morning: "We will take full responsibility until the end to ensure that the Severe Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Office launch stably on October 2, leaving no gaps in follow-up laws, regulations, and institutional preparations." (한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 본회의 표결을 앞두고 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “후속 법령과 제도 정비까지 빈틈없이 챙겨 10월 2일 중수청(중대범죄수사청), 공소청이 안정적으로 출범할 수 있도록 끝까지 책임을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Vote After 24-Hour Filibuster... Two Ruling Party Defectors (24시간 필리버스터 뒤 표결…여당선 2명 당론 이탈)

The bill to abolish supplementary investigative powers was submitted to the National Assembly by the Democratic Party's Criminal Procedure Act Revision Task Force (TF) on the 9th, with Rep. Kim Han-gyu, Deputy Chief Policy Whip, as the lead proposer, and was processed at the plenary session just 22 days later. The review of legislation heralding major changes to the criminal justice system took less than a month from proposal to passage, during which the opposition People Power Party protested, saying, "The opposition is merely a spectator; the Democratic Party is speeding through legislation according to a schedule it has laid out." (보완수사권 폐지 개정안은 민주당 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)가 지난 9일 김한규 원내정책수석부대표 대표발의로 법안을 국회에 제출하고 22일 만에 본회의에서 처리됐다. 형사사법체계의 중대 변화를 예고하는 법안 심사가 발의되고 처리까지 채 한달도 걸리지 않은 것으로, 이 기간 야당인 국민의힘은 “야당은 들러리일 뿐 민주당이 짜놓은 일정표대로 입법에 속도를 내고 있다”고 반발했다.)

Even after the bill reached the plenary session, the People Power Party attempted to block its passage through a filibuster (unlimited debate), but that afternoon, ruling bloc lawmakers including the Democratic Party ended the filibuster in accordance with the National Assembly Act. (법안이 본회의에 오른 뒤에도 국민의힘은 필리버스터(무제한 토론)로 법안 처리 저지에 나섰지만 이날 오후 민주당 등 범여권 의원들은 필리버스터를 국회법에 따라 종결시켰다.)

In the plenary vote that followed, held with People Power Party lawmakers absent, 175 of the 178 lawmakers present voted in favor, 2 voted against, and 1 abstained. Although it was a party-line vote for the Democratic Party, Rep. Kwak Sang-eon of the Democratic Party voted against, and fellow party Rep. Lee So-young abstained. The other lawmaker who voted against was Rep. Lee Ju-young of the Reform Party. Rep. Kwak wrote on Facebook: "I can see the suffering of the people that is coming, and I can hear the people's tears in my ears, so I could not make any other choice." (이후 국민의힘 의원들의 불참 속에 진행된 본회의 표결에서 재석의원 178명 중 175명이 찬성하고 2명이 반대, 1명이 기권했다. 민주당 당론 법안 표결이었으나, 곽상언 민주당 의원이 반대표를, 같은 당 이소영 의원이 기권표를 던졌다. 반대표를 던진 다른 의원은 이주영 개혁신당 의원이다. 곽 의원은 페이스북에 “곧 다가올 국민의 고통이 눈에 보이고 국민의 눈물이 귀에 들리는데 다른 선택을 할 수 없었다”고 썼다.)

A first-term Democratic Party lawmaker told the Hankyoreh that day: "In the prosecution reform process, the policy goal should have been to adjust the excessive authority of state institutions while ensuring no harm to the people in the process—discussions should have been balanced." He added, "It's regrettable that the discussion drifted toward making the stripping of power from a specific institution seem like the decisive goal of the policy." (한 민주당 초선 의원은 이날 한겨레에 “검찰개혁 과정에서 정책 목표가 국가기관의 과도한 권한을 조정하고 그 과정에서 국민 피해가 없어야 한다는 논의가 균형 있게 돼야 했었다”며 “특정 기관의 힘을 빼는 일이 정책의 결정적인 목표인 것처럼 논의가 흘러가버린 게 아쉽다”고 했다. )

A Year of Repeated Ruling-Opposition Conflict and Party-Presidential Office Differences (여야 대립, 당-청 입장차 반복된 1년)

With the completion of the legislation abolishing supplementary investigative powers that day, the prosecution reform legislation separating investigation and prosecution, which had proceeded in stages over the past year, has come to a close. Following then-Representative Jung Chung-rae's pledge at the Democratic Party's August 2 national convention last year to "bring news of the abolition of the prosecution service to the Chuseok dinner table," the government and ruling party had already passed the Government Organization Act revision including the abolition of the prosecution service in September of that year. After concluding the first stage of prosecution reform legislation, the government and ruling party passed the bills to establish the Severe Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Office in March, and completed the abolition of supplementary investigative powers that day. (이날 보완수사권 폐지 입법 마무리로 지난해부터 1년여간 단계적으로 이어진 수사·기소 분리 검찰개혁 입법이 일단락됐다. 정부·여당은 ‘추석 밥상에 검찰청 폐지 소식을 올리겠다’는 정청래 전 대표의 지난해 8·2 민주당 전당대회 공약에 따라 검찰청 폐지를 포함한 정부조직법 개정안을 같은 해 9월 우선 통과시킨 바 있다. 1단계 검찰개혁 입법을 매듭지은 정부·여당은 지난 3월 중수청·공소청 설치법안을 처리했고, 이날 보완수사권 폐지 법안 처리까지 마무리했다.)

Throughout this process, tensions between the ruling and opposition parties, as well as between the party and the presidential office, frequently escalated. A representative example was when the government proposal created by the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office was once 'rejected' by the ruling party during the processing of the bills to establish the SCIO and PPO, and when the resubmitted government proposal faced fierce opposition from hardliners within the ruling party and was substantially revised. (이 과정에서 여야 갈등과 더불어 당-청 간의 긴장감도 수시로 고조됐다. 중수청·공소청 설치법안 처리 과정에서 총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단이 만든 정부안이 한차례 여당에서 ‘반려’되고, 이후 다시 제출된 정부안을 두고도 여당 내 강경파의 거센 반발 속에 대거 수정됐던 일이 대표적이다.)

Although President Lee has publicly mentioned on several occasions since last year—including as recently as recent press conferences and social media posts—the need for some exceptional retention of supplementary investigative powers, the fact that the hardline stance within the ruling party favoring complete abolition ultimately held the 'initiative' in legislation is widely assessed as a scene rarely seen in early-term party-presidential office relations. (이 대통령이 지난해부터 최근까지도 기자회견이나 사회관계망서비스(SNS) 등을 통해 공개적으로 보완수사권 일부 예외적 존치 필요성 수차례 언급했지만, 여당 내 강경한 보완수사권 폐지 여론이 결국 입법 ‘주도권’을 쥔 점도 임기 초반 당-청 관계에선 흔히 나타나지 않는 장면이란 평가가 적잖다.)

That day, the presidential office issued a statement under the name of Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communications Sung Ki-hong saying, "We respect the legislative process and final judgment of the National Assembly." It also stated, "We will do our utmost to ensure that this revision is implemented without disruption in the field and that the people can feel the change in their daily lives." (이날 청와대는 성기홍 홍보소통수석 명의로 “국회의 입법 과정과 최종 판단을 존중한다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 또 “이번 개정안이 현장에서 차질 없이 시행되고, 국민이 삶 속에서 그 변화를 체감할 수 있게 최선을 다하겠다”고도 했다.)

A second-term lawmaker said: "Prosecution reform has long been an aspiration of the Democratic Party and the ruling bloc's supporters, but using that aspiration as justification, the management of the overall legislative process was too rough for a ruling party." He added, "I think it's worth reflecting on whether there were shortcomings in drawing public consensus during the process of shaping the specific details." (한 재선 의원은 “검찰개혁이 민주당과 여권 지지층의 오랜 열망이긴 하나, 그 열망을 이유로 전반의 입법 과정 관리가 집권여당에 걸맞지 않게 거칠었다”며 ”구체 내용을 만들어가는 과정에서 국민적 동의를 끌어내는 데 부족함이 있었던 것은 아닌지도 되짚어볼 필요가 있다고 본다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Joint Lithium Investment... Oil Imports Starting Next Year" at Argentina Summit (이 대통령, 아르헨티나 정상회담서 “리튬 공동투자… 내년부터 원유 수입”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Argentina, agreed on the 31st (local time) with President Javier Milei, during their summit, to pursue investments and joint projects by companies from both countries across the entire value chain of lithium, including exploration and mining. (아르헨티나를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 31일(현지시각) 하비에르 밀레이 대통령과 정상회담을 계기로 리튬의 탐사·채굴 등 밸류체인 전반에서 양국 기업의 투자와 공동 프로젝트를 추진하기로 했다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said at a briefing in Buenos Aires that day, "Through this summit, we have established a cooperation framework for the supply chain of critical minerals needed for future industries," adding, "The two countries signed a 'Memorandum of Understanding on Critical Minerals Cooperation' to share information on policies and investment systems related to critical minerals." Director Wi added, "Furthermore, we reaffirmed the Argentine government's continued commitment to support lithium projects being pursued by our companies, and we plan to explore expanding investment opportunities for our companies into new critical mineral sectors such as copper." Argentina is the world's third-largest lithium producer and holds the world's fourth-largest lithium reserves. This cooperation is expected to serve as an opportunity to stabilize the supply chain of key battery materials and expand the investment base for our companies. <<> A practical foundation was also laid to expand oil supply sources to South America. Director Wi said, "Our companies conducted a pilot introduction of Argentine crude oil this year, and based on that, imports are expected to begin starting next year," adding, "Through this visit, both governments have agreed to cooperate to ensure that the oil imports scheduled for next year proceed smoothly." Director Wi continued, "This is expected to serve as an opportunity to broaden our oil import sources, currently concentrated in the Middle East, to South America, reduce geopolitical uncertainties, and enhance our responsiveness in energy supply and demand," and said, "The two countries have agreed to expand the scope of energy cooperation beyond crude oil to include natural gas and nuclear power, and to jointly identify specific cooperative projects." This agreement is seen as a foundation for diversifying the oil import structure heavily reliant on the Middle East and enhancing the stability of the energy supply chain. <<> Additionally, efforts were made to improve the institutional environment to support our companies' market entry. Director Wi said, "The two countries have finalized a Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement, which is expected to reduce the double taxation burden on our companies operating in Argentina and increase the predictability of the investment environment," and "Additionally, both countries have agreed to push for the swift resumption of negotiations on a Korea-MERCOSUR trade agreement to expand our companies' access to the South American market." The two countries also agreed to reactivate the 'Joint Economic Committee' and the 'Energy and Resources Cooperation Committee' to continuously manage the outcomes of the summit. <<> Additionally, Director Wi mentioned, "President Milei said he is a 'fan of Korean cosmetics,'" and "Both countries agreed that there is significant room for the cosmetics market to grow dramatically." <<> Buenos Aires/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 부에노스아이레스 현지 브리핑에서 “이번 정상회담을 계기로 미래산업에 필요한 핵심광물 공급망 협력체계를 마련했다”며 “양국은 ‘핵심광물 협력 양해각서’를 체결해 핵심광물 관련 정책과 투자제도에 관한 정보를 공유하기로 했다”고 말했다. 위 실장은 이어 “아울러 우리 기업이 추진 중인 리튬 사업에 대한 아르헨티나 정부의 지속적인 지원 의지를 재확인했고, 구리 등 새로운 핵심광물 분야로 우리 기업의 투자 기회 확대를 모색할 예정”이라고 덧붙였다. 아르헨티나는 세계 3위 리튬 생산국이자 세계 4위 리튬 매장량을 보유한 국가로, 이번 협력은 배터리 핵심 원료의 공급망을 안정화하고 우리 기업의 현지 투자 기반을 확대하는 계기가 될 것으로 기대된다.)

item.title: Won Seong-ryeol on Claims of 30,000 North Korean Troops: "Closely Monitoring North Korea-Russia Military Cooperation" (위성락, 북 3만명 파병설에 “북·러 군사협력 예의주시”)
item.description:
National Security Office Director Won Seong-ryeol, accompanying the president on his tour of South America, said on the 31st (local time), "We are watching the military cooperation between Russia and North Korea with great interest and concern. Such military cooperation runs counter to Security Council resolutions." (대통령의 남미 순방에 동행 중인 위성락 국가안보실장이 31일(현지시각) “러시아와 북한 간 군사협력에 대해선 큰 관심과 우려를 가지고 보고 있다. 이런 군사협력은 안보리 결의에 저촉된다”고 말했다.)

At a briefing in Buenos Aires, Argentina, that day, Director Won responded to reporters' questions about "the claim by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy that North Korea has dispatched 30,000 soldiers," saying, "Cooperation between Russia and North Korea, including the combat situation in Ukraine, is a major concern for us." He added, "It is related to our security interests and has a significant impact on the international situation, so we are paying close attention. Whenever relevant information arises, we will gather and verify it further." Director Won did not directly answer whether the troop deployment had occurred. <<> Director Won further stated, "The principle is that every country must uphold Security Council resolutions," adding, "This is even more true for a responsible permanent member. Military cooperation (between Russia and North Korea) is directly tied to security, so this is not someone else's business." His remarks suggest that Russia, as a permanent member of the UN Security Council, bears responsibility for maintaining international peace and security and therefore has an obligation to comply with Security Council resolutions. Director Won continued, "We will closely monitor what is happening in Ukraine and respond accordingly," and "We aim to prevent things from worsening and to steer them toward reduction and elimination." <<> Earlier, on the 27th of last month, President Zelenskyy claimed that North Korea plans to dispatch an additional 30,000 troops to Russia. <<> Buenos Aires/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 위 실장은 이날 아르헨티나 부에노스아이레스 현지 브리핑에서 ‘볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령이 주장한 북한의 군인 3만명 파병설’과 관련한 취재진의 질문에 “우크라이나에서 전투 상황을 포함해 러시아와 북한 간 협력 등은 우리의 주요 관심 사안”이라며 “우리의 안보적 이해와도 관련되고 국제 정세에 미치는 영향도 커서 주목하고 있다. 관련 정보가 있을 때마다 추가 파악하고 검증하려고 한다”고 말했다. 위 실장은 파병 여부에 대한 즉답은 하지 않았다.)

item.title: Wi Sung-lac: "Reviewing Contributions to Hormuz... Not a Decision for the Government Alone" (위성락 “호르무즈 기여 검토… 정부 혼자 결정할 사안 아니다”)
item.description:
Wi Sung-lac, the National Security Office Director accompanying President Lee Jae-myung on his South America tour, said on the 31st (local time) regarding South Korea's "substantive contribution plan" in the Strait of Hormuz, "The U.S. hasn't made specific demands; we're in consultations to the extent of exploring what areas we can contribute to." (이재명 대통령의 남미 순방에 동행 중인 위성락 국가안보실장이 31일(현지시각) 호르무즈해협에서 한국의 ‘실질적 기여 방안’에 대해 “구체적으로 (미국이) 요구하진 않고, 우리가 할 수 있는 영역에 대해 타진하는 정도의 협의를 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

At a briefing held in Buenos Aires, Argentina, that day, when asked by reporters whether the U.S. had requested the deployment of specific military assets and whether the government was considering deploying military assets independent of U.S. requests, Director Wi said, "We're reviewing various possibilities," adding, "This isn't something the government can decide alone; there are still steps to take, such as building consensus in the National Assembly and with public opinion." ( 위 실장은 이날 아르헨티나 부에노스아이레스 현지 브리핑에서 ‘미측으로부터 구체적인 군자산 파견을 요청받았는지, 미측 요청과 별개로 군자산 파견을 검토하고 있는지’ 등을 묻는 취재진의 질문에 “여러 가능성을 검토하고 있다”며 “정부가 혼자 정할 수 있는 건 아니고, 국회, 여론 공감대 등 이뤄갈 일이 남아있긴 하다”고 말했다.)

He further stated, "Freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz is a critical interest for our economic security," adding, "Under the stance of actively participating and contributing in that process, we're reviewing what's feasible." ( 그러면서 위 실장은 “호르무즈해협의 자유통항은 우리의 경제안보에 있어 중요한 이해관계”라며 “그런 과정에 적극적으로 참여하고 기여한다는 입장 아래 가능한 걸 검토하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Buenos Aires/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 부에노스아이레스/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
